incidents.name: TGBS public _burnBlock()
incidents.notes: TGBS exposes _burnBlock(), which burns TGBS held by the TGBS/WBNB pair, so the attacker burned the pool down inside a DODO flash loan and sold its TGBS into the inflated reserves.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xedecfA18CAE067b2489A2287784a543069f950F4 created 2024-02-09T12:25:55Z by 0xd9d9eb8988ed6a10a9246287ce0d938e618a17ff, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xff1db040e4f2a44305e28f8de728dabff58f01e1; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
